data.one_liner: Javascript Object Signing and Encryption library supporting JWE, JWS, JWK and JWT.
data.what_it_does: Provides support for Javascript Object Signing and Encryption (JOSE), allowing developers to handle JSON Web Signature (JWS), JSON Web Encryption (JWE), JSON Web Key (JWK), and JSON Web Token (JWT) in Dart and Flutter. It supports a wide range of signing, key wrapping, and encryption algorithms.
use_when: You need to decode, verify, and validate JSON Web Tokens (JWT) in your application.
You need to sign and encrypt payloads using JSON Web Signature (JWS) and JSON Web Encryption (JWE).
avoid_when: You do not use JWT, JWS, JWE, or JWK standards in your application's architecture.
strengths: Comprehensive algorithm support for both JWS and JWE.
Supports serialization, parsing, and cryptographic operations for JWTs and JWKs.
weaknesses: Maintenance depends heavily on community and individual author sponsorship.
Not documented for platforms beyond the core Dart capabilities and standard Flutter targets.
